snippet.title: FEAR OF FAITH | INTRO CINEMATIC | (2026)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312250/FEAR_OF_FAITH/

FEAR OF FAITH is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers. Choose your class, combine spells and drink BEER to keep your FEAR away, or face a fate worse than DEATH

Coming to STEAM EARLY ACCESS on August 21!

PROVE YOUR FAITH
FACE YOUR FEAR

Voice acting by Sandigo Studio @Sandigo_Studio 
Cast: Sergiy Soldatov and Volynyatko

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY: https://discord.gg/jfEyANNym3

INSTAGRAM: https://www.instagram.com/fear.of.faith/
TWITTER (X): https://x.com/fear_of_faith

Want to join our crew? Let us know:

TELEGRAM: https://t.me/fofjoin
